ambiguities.fragment: If the detector detects damage to the pane
ambiguities.explanation: The conditional clause 'If the detector detects damage to the pane' is semantically ambiguous. It could mean either that the system informs the security service only when the detector has detected damage, or that the system informs the security service regardless of whether the detector has detected damage but the damage is to the pane.
possible_interpretations: The system informs the security service only when the detector has detected damage to the pane.
The system informs the security service regardless of whether the detector has detected damage, but if the damage is to the pane, then the system informs the security service.
textual_evidence: If the detector detects damage to the pane
